test_title: PYST 30: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 18 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

After receiving the parcel, she immedietely opened it.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'immedietely'.**

 
• **The correct spelling would be 'immediately'.**
 
• The word '**immediately**' is an **adverb** which means 'at once; instantly'. **(तुरंत)**
